name: Shivalik Bimetal Controls Ltd
tagline: NSE: SBCL | EXCLUDED - already upper-midcap (~Rs 5,995 Cr), at all-time high
summary: India's only fully integrated manufacturer of precision thermostatic bimetals, low-ohmic shunt resistors, silver contacts, bus bar connectors, and PCBA assemblies (est. 1984). Source sheet noted it as a niche manufacturing example, with a separate deeper session at the IAS2026 summit.
fundamentals_table: Hit an all-time high of Rs 796.05 on Jul 3, 2026, per MarketsMojo, 'momentum building across timeframes'
fundamentals_narrative: A genuinely unique, fully-integrated niche manufacturer with excellent capital efficiency (ROCE 26.8%, ROE 21.8%) and real double-digit growth, currently at an all-time high with confirmed multi-timeframe momentum. Already an upper-midcap at ~Rs 6,000 Cr though, and the P/E (56.2x) already reflects significant optimism.
technical_read: Confirmed strong, current momentum - all-time high with 'momentum building across timeframes' per independent MarketsMojo coverage.
sentiment_summary: Source sheet flagged this for a 'separate deeper session' at the summit - suggesting genuine analyst/community interest beyond a passing mention.
bse_notes: Not researched further given the size-based exclusion.
